lost_reasons.krill: Issues swallowing capsules, health issues; individual counts per reason not specified
lost_reasons.control: Lost interest, health issues; individual counts per reason not specified

hierarchy.abstract_neuromuscular_label: Secondary in abstract, exploratory under main Methods definition
hierarchy.multiplicity: Bonferroni post-hoc t-tests after significant repeated-measures ANOVA interactions; no overall family correction across secondary/exploratory endpoints described.

source_qualification.analysis: Two-way repeated-measures ANOVA time/group/time*group, normality/skewness checked, baseline unpaired t-tests; no baseline-covariate ANCOVA described.

parent_outcomes.status: Unreconciled published discrepancy; do not silently repair.

direct_final_score_credit.grip: Explicit corrected post-hoc higher krill vs control at6months

subgroup.role: Exploratory secondary analysis of the same NCT04048096 participants, not independent replication
subgroup.BMI_count_conflict: Printed krill BMI groups sum to50, conflicting with49 total; not repaired.

cutoffs_as_printed.BMI: normal<=24.9; overweight/obese>25 kg/m2; exact boundary unclear

subgroup.model: Mixed-design ANOVA (afex): Time within person; Group and Sex/Age/BMI between people; estimated marginal means (emmeans); Bonferroni post-hoc pairwise comparisons.
subgroup.power: Explicitly not powered for subgroup interactions; exploratory. No demonstrated global multiplicity correction across outcomes/subgroup interactions.

BMI_three_way_results.other_strength_p_labels: BMI Results prints Age labels for grip .950, thickness .893, walk .893, chair .626; retain label ambiguity.

subgroup.interpretation: No strength subgroup equivalence established; actual nominal sex*Mwave interaction is retained as exploratory, not inferred from within-group P values. No recommendation by sex/BMI/age. Reporting issues retained.

source_discrepancies.issue: The main labels the analysis ITT, but Fig.1 shows 102 randomized, 94 analyzed and eight postrandomization losses/exclusions. No imputation or full randomized-population sensitivity method is supplied.
source_discrepancies.handling: Preserve the label and actual flow; full-102 ITT is not demonstrated.

source_discrepancies.issue: The abstract prints a 17% M-wave effect and the Results prints 25.4%, both with 95% CI 12.7–38.1.
source_discrepancies.handling: Retain both source statements; no averaging or silent repair.

source_discrepancies.locator: Methods 2.4, abstract and current registry outcomes
source_discrepancies.issue: The registry labels body fat and lean mass secondary; the main Methods calls outcomes outside its narrower list exploratory, while the abstract labels neuromuscular measures secondary.
source_discrepancies.handling: Primary knee-strength hierarchy is consistent; preserve uncertainty for other endpoints.

source_discrepancies.locator: Subgroup native Table 1/p3 and XML tbl0005
source_discrepancies.issue: Printed krill BMI subgroup counts are 24 normal weight plus 26 overweight/obese, totaling 50 versus 49 krill participants overall.
source_discrepancies.handling: Do not silently change a denominator or invent the analysis n.

source_discrepancies.issue: The BMI Results section switches several interaction labels to Group*Age*Time while discussing BMI.
source_discrepancies.handling: Preserve printed label/section context; no precise model reassignment.

source_discrepancies.issue: The male control M-wave change is printed as −3.71 [1.58–6.05] mV, P=.059. The effect sign, positive interval and nonsignificant P value are inconsistent as printed.
source_discrepancies.handling: Retain literal numbers and flag; no sign, CI or P-value repair.

source_discrepancies.issue: Tables 2 and 4 omit explicit sex/age labels above the two blocks. Fig.2 BMI torque control-change pattern conflicts with Table 3 subgroup ordering.
source_discrepancies.handling: Preserve source assets; no plot digitization or relabeling.

source_discrepancies.locator: Subgroup Results 3.4/p4 versus Results 3.2/p3 and Table 4/p6
source_discrepancies.issue: Age-specific grip effect estimates/CIs repeat the sex-specific figures verbatim despite different age-group descriptive patterns.
source_discrepancies.handling: Potential reporting inconsistency; exact age effects remain qualified. No reconstructed replacement.

source_discrepancies.issue: BMI cutoffs are printed as <=24.9 and >25 kg/m2; handling of the exact boundary is not explained.
source_discrepancies.handling: Do not assume an unprinted corrected threshold.

source_discrepancies.issue: Captions append all P<.05 while describing no change in controls; the abstract broadly mentions physical-function increases despite nonpositive walk/chair Results.
source_discrepancies.handling: Interpret formal controlled results; no function-positive or subgroup interaction inference from those phrases.
